definitions.short: some noted constellation (only in the plural), perhaps collectively, the zodiac
definitions.full: H4216. mazzaroth מַזָּרוֺת noun [feminine] plural probably = מַזָּלוֺת q. v. above (on ר = ל see W SG 67 , yet also Nö ZMG xi.1886, 185 ) only מ ׳הֲתֹצִיא בְּעִתּוֺ Job 38:32 , where treated as masculine singular, and perhaps understood of some particular star or constellation. ᵐ5 μαζουρωθ . מִזְרָח see זרח . מְזָרִים see זרה Pi`el 1. [ מִזְרָע ] see I. זרע . מִזְרָק see זרק . [ מֵחַ ], מֹחַ see מחח .
